opening.argument: The presentation promotes an Ethereum arbitrage method through Biftex and Binance while attaching a substantial return claim to the procedure. It states, “Today I will show you how to earn 10% on Ethereum arbitrage using the Biftex exchange,” then directs viewers to fund an Ethereum wallet: “Go to the deposit and replenish our Ethereum wallet.” It proceeds through trading and withdrawal steps, including selling the deposited Ethereum and displaying a withdrawal form, while expressly encouraging repetition: “Try it yourself according to this scheme.” These instructions present a way to deposit and move cryptocurrency in pursuit of claimed returns. The displayed balances, rates, withdrawal, and returns are not independently verified as genuine or reproducible, so the presentation supports the asserted scheme without establishing that its results can be achieved.
